module: Flowgraph node 'Sequencer' (logic category). Activates the flow outputs value_1..value_N in turn. Increment mode 'auto' (+1 per frame), 'manual' (pins next/reset/count) or 'select' (pin index). Sequence mode: loop, random, once (pingpong is defined but not offered). Hidden outputs currentIndex, maxIndex, totalIndex.
notes: The C.todo field in the code notes that the index starts at 2 in auto mode.
In work, 'self.mode == manual' is tested whereas 'manual' is an increment mode: self.pinIn.count is therefore never used and c = self.count.
In pingpong mode with count=1, modulo 0 (not offered in the UI).
updatePins does not delete the links of the removed pins.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

updateMode.desc: Adds/deletes the input pins according to the increment mode (index for select; next, reset, count for manual).

drawCustomProperties.desc: Panel: increment mode, sequence mode (except select), number of outputs.

updatePins.desc: Creates or deletes the flow outputs value_i.

_onDeserialized.desc: Reads back the settings, recreates the pins and the mode.

work.desc: Updates the index according to the increment mode, computes the active output, sets value_i to (i == active), writes currentIndex, maxIndex, totalIndex; flow equals the input flow.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the mode and the current index.
